description: AIBL 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：aibl 质控汇总；aibl 表型/刺激提取；aibl 复制整理为 BIDS 目录。

method_refs.label: aibl 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries and exclusion lists for AIBL. Combines fMRIPrep confounds (if available), FreeSurfer recon-all metrics, and structural quality assessment to produce a unified QC report。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory); freesurfer_dir: Path to FreeSurfer output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: aibl 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge AIBL phenotype tables for downstream analysis. Reads AIBL phenotype files (cognitive assessments, blood biomarkers, APOE genotype, demographics), selects columns, aligns visits, and optionally cross-references with imaging subject lists。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing AIBL phenotype CSV/TSV files (directory); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: aibl 复制整理为 BIDS 目录
method_refs.role: Reorganize AIBL raw data into BIDS-style directory structure. Handles AIBL-style subject IDs, visit names, and multimodal routing for T1w MRI and PET (PiB, FDG, tau)。 Inputs: input: Path to AIBL raw data directory (directory); participants_file: Optional: path to AIBL phenotype file for participant metadata (file). Registered outputs: results/.

name: aibl-skill
